item.title: Lovecubus! ~Onna no Ko Akuma ♀♂ Otoko no Ko Akuma~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CuteRush
  • 発売日: 2016-01-29
  • スコア: 6.99/10 (54 人評価)
  • 日本語名: らぶきゅばす！ ～おんなのこあくま♀♂おとこのこあくま～
  • 英語名: Lovecubus! Onna no Ko Akuma ♀♂ Otoko no Ko Akuma

あらすじ

The Protagonist Tarou has a correspondent who is an English girl. One day, his correspondent Elena’s family moves to Japan and they meet for the first time. With an awful start to their meeting, a dislike for each other emerges. Tarou is handed a handwritten book from Elena, and as he flips through the pages he recalls memories of his previous life.
